description: A React component for rendering various types of select fields in a Mattermost app form, supporting dynamic, static, user, and channel selections with async loading.

classes.name: AppsFormSelectField
classes.description: A React component class for rendering different types of select input fields with support for async data loading and multi-select options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with the provided field and a refresh nonce.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates the component state when props change, particularly the field and refresh nonce.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events for the select inputs, calling the provided onChange prop.

methods.name: loadDynamicOptions
methods.description: Loads options dynamically based on user input for general select types.

methods.name: loadDynamicUserOptions
methods.description: Loads user options asynchronously, filtering out bots and formatting labels.

methods.name: loadDynamicChannelOptions
methods.description: Loads channel options asynchronously based on user input.

methods.name: renderDynamicSelect
methods.description: Renders a dynamic select component with async options.

methods.name: renderUserSelect
methods.description: Renders a user select component with async options.

methods.name: renderChannelSelect
methods.description: Renders a channel select component with async options.

methods.name: renderStaticSelect
methods.description: Renders a static select component with predefined options.

methods.name: getAppFieldRenderer
methods.description: Returns the appropriate render method based on the field type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that displays the select component and help text.
